breeds.name: Norwegian Forest Cat
breeds.temperament: Sweet, Active, Intelligent, Social, Playful, Lively, Curious, Independent
breeds.description: Large, sturdy cat with long, water-resistant double coat and strong build. Natural breed adapted to cold Norwegian climate.
breeds.history: Ancient natural breed that developed in Norwegian forests. Featured in Norse mythology as the skogkatt. Nearly extinct after WWII but preserved by Norwegian breeders. National cat of Norway.
